text: Samarth Pratap Singh is an AI Engineer currently pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering at VIT Bhopal University (2023–2027) with a CGPA of 8.61. Headline: 'I build LLM systems, then measure them.' He builds RAG pipelines, document extraction, and the evaluation harnesses behind them. He is actively seeking AI/LLM engineering roles for 2027.

Samarth's technical skills: Languages: Python, C++, TypeScript, SQL. ML/DL: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, PEFT/LoRA, Scikit-learn. LLM and Agents: LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, Tool-Calling, FastMCP. Retrieval: Qdrant, FAISS, Hybrid Search (BM25+Dense), RRF Fusion, Cross-Encoder Reranking. Backend and Infra: FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Next.js, Concurrency (asyncio). Delivery: Docker, Azure Container Apps, GitHub Actions CI/CD, pytest, LangSmith. Eval and Observability: LLM-as-Judge, Ragas, LangSmith, MLflow.

Experience: AI/ML Engineering Intern at AmberFlux EdgeAI Private Limited, May 2026 to Present, Remote (Hyderabad, Telangana). Architected a vision extraction pipeline for multi-page architectural PDFs using GPT-5 — cut latency from ~7 min to ~90 sec on 20-page drawings (~4.7×) via concurrent batch dispatch (ThreadPoolExecutor + asyncio), with structured output enforcement and retry handling. Built a cover/dimension intake pipeline combining non-AI heuristic extraction (regex/Docling) with conditional GPT-5 fallback — vision invoked only for missing fields — achieving >0.85 confidence on real architectural lead sheets. Designed a job aggregation layer consolidating multi-source document outputs into structured JSON for documents up to 400 pages, with page-level validation guardrails, drawing-page exclusion, and LangGraph-routed aggregation.

Project: DoCopilot — Multi-Tenant RAG Document Q&A. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Qdrant, Hybrid Search, Cross-Encoder Reranking, Docker, Azure Container Apps. Multi-tenant RAG system featuring JWT auth, Qdrant payload-filtered retrieval, SHA-256 upload dedup, Celery + Redis async ingestion, hybrid retrieval (MiniLM dense + BM25, RRF), and cross-encoder rerank top-20 to top-5. Evaluated with 40-question test harness (Llama-3.1-8B judging Qwen3-32B) achieving 89.2% correctness, 90.5% relevance, and 2.86s average latency. Live demo: https://do-copilot.vercel.app/. GitHub: https://github.com/noviciusss/DoCopilot.

Project: Argus — Multi-Agent Research Engine. Stack: FastAPI, LangGraph, Docker, LangSmith, SQLite/Postgres. Built an autonomous research supervisor graph with 4 specialists (planner, researcher, critic, writer) routed dynamically via Command(goto). Features 3 depth tiers (~20/45/90s), HITL interrupt isolated in own node, maximum 3 critique loops, 30-min auto-finalize, and LangSmith observability. GitHub: github.com/noviciusss/argus. Live demo: argus-h0uw.onrender.com.

Project: ContextCore — Stateful Memory Agent. Stack: LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, MongoDB, FastMCP. LangGraph CLI agent with intent router and custom FastMCP server. Three memory layers: Postgres checkpointing for execution state, Qdrant semantic recall, MongoDB user profile. LLM-judge eval over 50 test cases with 92% pass rate. GitHub: github.com/noviciusss/ContextCore-CLI.

Project: GFS-AI — Document Intelligence Pipeline (AmberFlux EdgeAI internship). Stack: GPT-5 Vision, ThreadPoolExecutor, asyncio, Docling, LangGraph, Python. Vision extraction pipeline combining regex/Docling checks with GPT-5 fallback. Cut latency from ~7 min to ~90 sec on 20-page architectural drawings (~4.7×). Tested on documents up to 400 pages with >0.85 confidence on real lead sheets.

Published Models and Archive: FLAN-T5 Dialogue Summarizer: LoRA fine-tuned FLAN-T5-base on SAMSum (14,700 dialogues), updating 2% of parameters. Achieved 49.01 ROUGE-1, 72.25 BERTScore F1, 42.51 METEOR. Hosted on Hugging Face Spaces. RoBERTa Banking77 Classifier: Fine-tuned RoBERTa-base on Banking77 dataset (77 intents, 13K queries) achieving 93.7% accuracy and 93.6% macro-F1. Project Loom: Next.js full-stack project board.
Contact and social links: GitHub: github.com/noviciusss. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/spsamar. Email: samarthsin2006@gmail.com. Contact form available on the portfolio website.

Hobbies and Interests: I am an avid reader of manhwa and enjoy playing video games. I love learning about AI and its core basics from the absolute fundamentals, and I am currently learning AI system design.

Favorite Sports and Players: I love playing and watching cricket and football. My favorite players are Rohit Sharma in cricket and Cristiano Ronaldo in football (I absolutely love his competitive ego!).
Favorite Food: I love Schezwan noodles, and nothing beats homemade food cooked by my mother.
Favorite Music: My favorite singer is Arijit Singh.

Hardware Setup: I own and proudly run a Lenovo Legion 5 Pro powerhouse laptop, packed with an Intel Core i9-14900HX processor and an NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU. It is my main workstation for handling local agent testing, heavy tokenizers, and dataset evaluation runs.

Future Plans and Career Targets: I am actively targeting AI/ML and LLMOps engineering roles, applying both on-campus and off-campus to join dedicated AI teams and make significant contributions. Currently, I am learning AI system design, exploring Voice AI, Computer Vision (CV) AI, and advanced RAG architectures. I also plan to implement Andrej Karpathy's 'ChatGPT from scratch' series locally. I seek challenging, competitive roles that force me to innovate and try new things (and of course, roles that pay well too!).

Engineering and Testing Philosophy: I believe that rigorous local testing is mandatory—you must manually verify and run different edge-case scenarios yourself before pushing code. Furthermore, robust evaluation (evals) is absolutely necessary for anything and everything in production AI/ML systems.

Learning Influences and Resources: I stay updated on AI developments by watching Andrej Karpathy's deep-dives, CampusX tutorials, and reading Medium articles (often using a browser extension to read the premium articles for free... typical engineer hacks!).
Favorite Movies and Sitcoms: I love watching movies and web series, particularly sitcoms. My favorite sitcoms of all time are The Big Bang Theory and Brooklyn Nine-Nine.
